description: The daily insight digest (spec 006, FR-008-FR-010). Explains an already-ranked finding set and already-computed figures; decides neither.

guardrail.note: Attached by infra (T020). Principle II names guardrails as part of the GenAI layer, and the digest's input is governance data belonging to a tenant.

actionGroups.name: governance-read
actionGroups.description: Read-only governance lookups through the platform HTTP API. Every operation is a GET; the agent principal is refused on every other method (FR-056, R-602).

info.title: Digest governance reads
info.description: A deliberately small surface. Each operation is backed by an endpoint specs 002-005 already ship; an operation needing a new data path is a spec change, not a definition change.

get.summary: Open findings for this tenant, newest first.
get.description: Use this to read detail about the findings named in the prompt. The prompt's selection is the digest's selection; this endpoint returning more of them does not widen it.

200.description: Findings with their resource, rule and severity.
